{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Satin slip dress with a fluid, knee-length silhouette in a soft rose hue (#D48C94) and liquid georgette fabric for effortless movement during the afternoon garden portion.
A lightweight unstructured blazer in crisp ivory linen with a relaxed fit and dropped shoulders to add polish while ensuring breathability against the August heat.
Strappy metallic gold sandals on a 3-inch block heel that transition seamlessly from the outdoor ceremony to the indoor reception dinner.
This ensemble honors her specific refusal of heavy layers or cold-weather gear by relying on breathable natural fibers like linen and silk suitable for midsummer temperatures. The choice of smart social formality balances the celebratory nature of a wedding guest appearance with the need for comfort during an extended evening event that moves from outdoors to a restaurant setting. By keeping the outer layer optional and airy, the look respects her wishes while maintaining elegance through rich textures and a sophisticated color palette."}
